remarks: Don't wait, this turn-key, light and bright 4 Bedroom, 2.1 Bathroom colonial won't last! Step into the renovated kitchen boasting white custom shaker cabinets, a white quartz countertops, subway tile backsplash, all brand new appliances. On the main floor you'll also find a formal living room with a brick fireplace, dining room, half bath and a bedroom. Walk outdoors to the patio area to enjoy the nice weather. The second floor has a generous primary room, with a closet, and private bath. along with two additional bedrooms and a full bath. A Fully finished basement offers endless possibilities. New roof, New driveway, New garage door and opener, New custom patio with fireplace, Fresh paint outside, refinish hardwood floors, New propane forced hot air furnace, New central ac New, renovated bathroom New lights fixture, pull down attic for extra storage.
